name: selectbeam
description: Beam your code straight to AI — no copy-paste, no tab-switching.

commands.title: SelectBeam: Send Selection to Browser AI (ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek)

selectbeam.defaultTarget.description: Where your code goes. Auto tries the terminal first and copies if needed. Clipboard always just copies. Terminal always uses the terminal.

selectbeam.rememberTerminalChoice.description: Remember which terminal you picked so you are asked once, not every time.

selectbeam.askForPrompt.description: Ask for a short note after your code, for example 'explain this'. Leave it empty to send code only. SelectBeam never presses Enter for you.

selectbeam.agentStartDelayMs.description: How long to wait after starting an AI tool before putting code in, so the tool has time to open. In milliseconds.

selectbeam.agentCommands.description: If one of your AI tools starts with a different command, write it here, for example { "copilot": "gh copilot" }.

selectbeam.defaultBrowser.description: Which browser AI to open. Ask shows a list every time. Last reuses your last pick. Or pick one directly.

selectbeam.rememberBrowserChoice.description: Remember your browser pick so Last works.

selectbeam.browserUrls.description: If a chat site address changes, write it here, for example { "deepseek": "https://chat.deepseek.com/" }.

selectbeam.reuseBrowserTab.description: Reuse the already-linked browser AI tab instead of opening a new tab every time. Needs the free SelectBeam browser companion (Firefox first). Falls back to opening the site if no live tab.

selectbeam.liveTabTTLMinutes.description: How long a linked browser tab is considered fresh. After this, SelectBeam opens the site again instead of reusing. In minutes.

selectbeam.bridgeEnabled.description: Run the local browser bridge (localhost HTTP, no internet needed) so the browser companion can report its live tab and pick up code. Turn off if you only use copy+open.

selectbeam.bridgePort.description: Localhost port for the browser bridge. Change only if this port is taken on your machine.
